author: Celeste
title: Café de Olla
ingredients: 4 tbsp ground coffee (we use Café Bustelo)
notes: Pour any leftover coffee into an airtight bottle and keep in the fridge for up to 3-4 days. Reheat in the microwave or on the stove.
You can also enjoy it over ice! Just let it cool all the way to room temperature first or keep it in the fridge until chilled.
Makes around 4 cups (1 litre) of coffee.
instructions_list: To a small saucepan, add the piloncillo, cinnamon stick, cloves, star anise, orange peel, and water. Place it over medium heat and stir occasionally until the sugar has dissolved.
Increase to medium-high heat and bring to a boil.
Once boiling, turn off the heat and quickly stir in the ground coffee. Cover and let it steep for 6 minutes.
Strain the coffee through a fine mesh sieve or cheesecloth and enjoy!
description: Café de Olla is a Mexican spiced coffee drink made with piloncillo, spices, and ground coffee. It's simple to make on the stove and it's great for spicing up your morning coffee routine.
